items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-27
items.q: You were referring to blues players like, maybe, Muddy Water, which you referred to something, I thought.

ctx.x: And then you had all these guitar players and singers and...

That was a big thing, that's where your blues was. Yeah. It wasn't in the bands, it was in individuals. You were referring to blues players like, maybe, Muddy Water, which you referred to something, I thought.
Even before that, I think about, you know, the Thomas family, Joyce W. Thomas, they came out of Houston.
